Adam Warlock.base_effect: Teammates linked by Soul Bond receive a Speed Boost.
Adam Warlock.enhanced_effect: With Storm, linked teammates additionally gain a Damage Boost.

Adam Warlock.base_effect: Cosmic Cluster provides healing to allies it hits.
Adam Warlock.enhanced_effect: With Ultron, Cosmic Cluster creates an explosion on impact.

Angela.base_effect: Reveals a targeted area, then can re-activate to slam and Ground enemies hit.
Angela.enhanced_effect: With Star-Lord, Angela gains Bonus Health based on enemies hit by the slam.

Angela.base_effect: Sends an illusion forward that uses Assassin's Charge and carries enemies struck head-on.
Angela.enhanced_effect: With Loki, the ability gains two charges.

Black Cat.base_effect: Damage taken builds Vibranium Energy; at threshold Black Cat can explode, damage and knock back nearby enemies, and gain Speed Boost and Bonus Health.
Black Cat.enhanced_effect: With Black Panther, the explosion can be triggered without waiting for the energy threshold.

Black Cat.base_effect: Turn of Fortune becomes Spider-Web Grapple with two charges; hits steal Fortune, apply Spider-Tracer, and enable bonus damage when detonated by other abilities.
Black Cat.enhanced_effect: With Spider-Man, grappling an already marked enemy briefly Immobilizes them.

Black Panther.base_effect: Triggers elemental power in Black Panther armor, damaging and Slowing nearby enemies while applying Vibranium Marks.
Black Panther.enhanced_effect: With Storm, enemies in range are launched toward Black Panther.

Black Panther.base_effect: Uses a Limbo stepping disc to return to a recent position, gaining Bonus Health; the disc later explodes and applies Vibranium Marks.
Black Panther.enhanced_effect: With Magik, the teleport sequence can be manually canceled mid-transit.

Black Widow.base_effect: Red Room Rifle hits build Focus; at three stacks the next bullet gains Hunter Sight, Damage Boost, and piercing effects.
Black Widow.enhanced_effect: With Hawkeye, critical hits prevent Focused state from expiring until a critical hit is missed.

Black Widow.base_effect: Activation boosts Red Room Rifle fire rate and turns Plasma Cannon into an uncharged hitscan laser.
Black Widow.enhanced_effect: With Phoenix, Plasma Cannon gains a second charge.

Blade.base_effect: Blade performs a forward cleave and short dash, then slashes four times to send bouncing Darkmoon Blades forward.
Blade.enhanced_effect: With Moon Knight, each Whirlwind Slash generates one extra Darkmoon Blade.

Blade.base_effect: Taking enough damage builds Bloodline Awakening stacks.
Blade.enhanced_effect: With Captain America, critical damage instantly triggers Bloodline Awakening, grants bonus stacks, and raises the stack cap.

Captain America.base_effect: Captain America leaps to an ally, gives both heroes Bonus Health, and redirects part of the ally damage to himself.
Captain America.enhanced_effect: With Winter Soldier, the duo can mutually rally, collide, grant nearby allies Bonus Health and Movement Speed, and speed up the targeted teammate.

Captain America.base_effect: Sentinel Strike becomes Lightning Shield. After landing two hits, Captain America throws piercing lightning shields.
Captain America.enhanced_effect: With Thor, Lightning Shield hits trigger extra area damage bursts.

Cloak & Dagger.base_effect: Cloak & Dagger enter a protective ice block, becoming frozen in place while still healable and emitting a weak healing aura.
Cloak & Dagger.enhanced_effect: With Luna Snow, the healing aura around the frozen block becomes significantly stronger.

Cloak & Dagger.base_effect: Veil of Lightforce and Terror Cape become stationary hellfire veils that weaken enemy damage or reduce enemy healing passing through them.
Cloak & Dagger.enhanced_effect: With The Hood, both veils become wider and allies passing through gain a temporary Damage Boost.

Cyclops.base_effect: Ricochet Force ignites enemies with Phoenix Force burn; Optic Blast or Concussive Beam can detonate part of the remaining burn damage.
Cyclops.enhanced_effect: With Phoenix, Spark detonations reduce Ricochet Force cooldown.

Cyclops.base_effect: Cyclops releases stored kinetic energy to gain greatly increased movement speed and jump height for a duration.
Cyclops.enhanced_effect: With Gambit, Optic Blast and Concussive Beam attack speeds increase during the enhanced state.

Daredevil.base_effect: Objection! improves Whirling Billy Clubs so they damage enemies in range, deflect projectiles from every direction, and restore Fury on successful deflects.
Daredevil.enhanced_effect: With Iron Fist, Daredevil passively heals for the duration.

Daredevil.base_effect: Daredevil swings Devil's Chain in a criss-cross pattern, damaging and Slowing enemies in front.
Daredevil.enhanced_effect: With Black Widow, the radius expands and hits restore Fury.

Deadpool.base_effect: Deadpool can upgrade either Desert Eagles or Katanas one extra time with Hel energy.
Deadpool.enhanced_effect: With Hela, both Desert Eagles and Katanas can be upgraded one extra time.

Deadpool.base_effect: Deadpool leaps forward with kinetic energy and scatters charged chimichangas on landing to damage enemies.
Deadpool.enhanced_effect: With Gambit, the landing blast Stuns enemies in its radius.

Devil Dinosaur.base_effect: Primal Bite is replaced by two magnetic cannons that fire explosive cannonballs.
Devil Dinosaur.enhanced_effect: With The Punisher, a mounted interaction lets The Punisher ride Devil Dinosaur with Damage Reduction while Devil Dinosaur absorbs part of his incoming damage.

Devil Dinosaur.base_effect: Impact Beam is replaced by a frontal water spray that damages enemies and heals allies.
Devil Dinosaur.enhanced_effect: With Jeff, Jeff can ride Devil Dinosaur; both gain Damage Reduction and Continuous Healing while Jeff is limited to selected abilities.

Doctor Strange.base_effect: Maelstrom of Madness becomes Gamma Maelstrom with faster energy charge and no Anti-Heal curse.
Doctor Strange.enhanced_effect: With Hulk, releasing Gamma Maelstrom preserves some energy and stored Gamma energy no longer decays.

Doctor Strange.base_effect: Maelstrom of Madness becomes Psionic Vortex, pulling enemies toward Doctor Strange and increasing Shield of the Seraphim shield value.
Doctor Strange.enhanced_effect: With Invisible Woman, Psionic Vortex damage converts proportionally into Bonus Health for Doctor Strange.

Elsa Bloodstone.base_effect: Smoky Snare deploys Diablo to monitor an area, Immobilize and damage approaching enemies, and release damaging gas.
Elsa Bloodstone.enhanced_effect: With Devil Dinosaur, Elsa can store and deploy two Smoky Snares.

Elsa Bloodstone.base_effect: Living Bullet fires special rounds that Taunt, Slow, and damage nearby enemies over time, then recall to heal Elsa and raise her Inherited Instinct cap.
Elsa Bloodstone.enhanced_effect: With Deadpool, Instinct acquisition rate is significantly boosted.

Emma Frost.base_effect: Damaging the summoned Soul Crystal can be converted into Bonus Health for Emma Frost.
Emma Frost.enhanced_effect: With Mantis, shattering the Soul Crystal grants one-time Bonus Health and reduces Mind Control cooldown.

Emma Frost.base_effect: Emma releases winter energy that damages and Slows enemies, and can form Zero Diamond during Diamond Form to block attacks and movement.
Emma Frost.enhanced_effect: With Luna Snow, Diamond Form causes ability damage and Soul Wave to apply Slow.

Gambit.base_effect: Gambit spins a firework-enhanced Bo Staff, healing nearby allies, damaging nearby enemies, and blocking most projectiles.
Gambit.enhanced_effect: With Jubilee, Bayou Bash and Big Easy Impact gain an additional Continuous Healing aura.

Gambit.base_effect: Gambit throws two magnetic cards that spin in place, healing allies they hit while damaging and Launching enemies.
Gambit.enhanced_effect: With Magneto, the cards slam together and explode at the end for extra healing and damage.

Groot.base_effect: Summons a Wild Wall that gives allies in range Continuous Healing and Bonus Health.
Groot.enhanced_effect: With Mantis, Wild Wall evolves after enough healing and increases its healing output.

Groot.base_effect: Groot retreats into a Bubble Shield, becoming Invincible and receiving Continuous Healing.
Groot.enhanced_effect: With Jeff, the bubble healing is stronger and excess healing converts into Bonus Health.

Hawkeye.base_effect: Blast Arrow becomes Psionic Arrow; Hawkeye can bank extra arrows while drawn and rapidly fire them on release.
Hawkeye.enhanced_effect: With Psylocke, arrow nocking is faster and arrows explode on impact.

Hawkeye.base_effect: Crescent Slash becomes Moonlit Slash, sending a radiant blade that heals allies, boosts healing, damages enemies, and applies Vulnerability.
Hawkeye.enhanced_effect: With Cloak & Dagger, Moonlit Slash chains into a three-hit light blade combo.

Hela.base_effect: Soul Drainer is replaced by Hel Tendrils, pulling nearby enemies toward the impact point and linking them with a Slow when they try to escape.
Hela.enhanced_effect: With Venom, Piercing Night fires symbiote-infused Nightsword Thorns and direct hits restore Hela's Health.

Hela.base_effect: Hela participation in a KO spawns an Undead Monstro that can spit Nightsword Thorns when Piercing Night is cast.
Hela.enhanced_effect: With Namor, each Goddess of Death attack spawns an Undead Monstro at the impact point.

Hulk.base_effect: Hulk leaps high and slams the ground, damaging enemies and reducing other cooldowns based on remaining Health.
Hulk.enhanced_effect: With Captain America, the slam also applies Vulnerability to enemies hit.

Hulk.base_effect: Hulk enters a Furious state with Speed Boost and Attack Speed, and gains Dances With Werewolves for Unstoppable at low Health.
Hulk.enhanced_effect: With Wolverine, Hulk unlocks Fastball Special and can throw Wolverine forward after mutual confirmation.

Human Torch.base_effect: Passively detects nearby enemies and launches tracking Sparks to chip their Health.
Human Torch.enhanced_effect: With Jubilee, landing a Firework Spark grants Human Torch Bonus Health.

Human Torch.base_effect: Fires a storm-driven blaze that creates a persistent Fire Vortex, damaging and pulling enemies.
Human Torch.enhanced_effect: With Storm, Omega Hurricane can become Burning Hurricane when crossing Flame Tornado, and storm/fire fields can generate new Flame Tornadoes.

Invisible Woman.base_effect: Invisible Woman creates a Flame Shield on an ally that blocks damage, heals nearby allies, boosts friendly projectiles fired through it, and Slows enemies passing through.
Invisible Woman.enhanced_effect: With Human Torch, the Flame Shield gains a larger radius and much higher shield value.

Invisible Woman.base_effect: Invisible Woman and nearby allies become Invisible, receiving healing and Speed Boost until damaged or expired, and can re-enter Invisible state after disengaging.
Invisible Woman.enhanced_effect: With Mister Fantastic, healing, Speed Boost, and Invisible duration are enhanced.

Iron Fist.base_effect: Iron Fist launches enemies upward with a powerful uppercut.
Iron Fist.enhanced_effect: With The Thing, the uppercut can chain into a sweeping leg follow-up.

Iron Fist.base_effect: Yat Jee Chung Kuen hits burst-heal nearby allies.
Iron Fist.enhanced_effect: With White Fox, Yat Jee Chung Kuen lock-on distance is greatly increased.

Iron Man.base_effect: Armor Overdrive becomes Gamma Overdrive, granting a Gamma Shield and stronger Repulsor Blasts and Unibeams.
Iron Man.enhanced_effect: With Hulk, Invincible Pulse Cannon creates a Gamma Shield and becomes a stronger Gamma Pulse Cannon.

Iron Man.base_effect: Unibeam is enhanced in and out of Armor Overdrive, forming lightning rings that deal bonus damage near the beam edge.
Iron Man.enhanced_effect: With Thor, Armor Overdrive cooldown is greatly reduced.

Jeff the Land Shark.base_effect: Jeff fires healing tendrils that link allies for continuous healing, converting excess healing into Bonus Health.
Jeff the Land Shark.enhanced_effect: With Venom, symbiote tendrils also lash nearby enemies for continuous damage.

Jeff the Land Shark.base_effect: Jeff spits out a Deadpool Plushie that Taunts nearby enemies while spraying healing mist on nearby allies.
Jeff the Land Shark.enhanced_effect: With Deadpool, the plushie's Taunt is stronger and it also damages enemies in its radius.

Jubilee.base_effect: Jubilee deploys a Vampiric Field where allies gain Life Steal while attacking enemies.
Jubilee.enhanced_effect: With Blade, allies inside the field also receive Continuous Healing.

Jubilee.base_effect: When Attack Speed is enhanced, Energy Plasmoids become a hitscan attack that can critically hit and heal Jubilee on hit.
Jubilee.enhanced_effect: With The Hood, Void Magic Mark is never cleared, allowing Jubilee to sustain the hitscan form indefinitely.

Loki.base_effect: Regeneration Domain's Rune Stones are enhanced with life energy, granting allies inside the field a Damage Boost.
Loki.enhanced_effect: With Mantis, Loki gains the Deific Blessing Team-Up effect through the Mantis anchor, improving Regeneration Domain's support field.

Loki.base_effect: Loki can target a fallen hero, ally or enemy, and assume that form temporarily without access to their Ultimate Ability.
Loki.enhanced_effect: With Hela, the transformation lasts longer and lethal damage while transformed or using God of Mischief reverts Loki with low Health instead of KO'ing him.

Luna Snow.base_effect: Luna sends a spirit fox forward that Charms enemies, heals allies in its path, and cleanses Luna of negative status effects.
Luna Snow.enhanced_effect: With White Fox, the spirit fox returns after reaching maximum distance and the self-cleanse remains available.

Luna Snow.base_effect: Soul Bond tethers nearby characters; damaging tethered enemies or healing linked allies restores Luna Snow Health.
Luna Snow.enhanced_effect: With Adam Warlock, Light & Dark Ice critical hits reduce Absolute Zero and Ice Arts cooldowns.

Magik.base_effect: Chain of Cyttorak can tether two enemies at once and drag both to the same location.
Magik.enhanced_effect: With Doctor Strange, Chain of Cyttorak can tether multiple enemies and pull the whole group to one point.

Magik.base_effect: Stepping Discs inside a Hellish Magic Circle refund energy and summon a Limbo Demon on each use.
Magik.enhanced_effect: With The Hood, summoned Limbo Demons gain much more Health and a wider attack range.

Magneto.base_effect: Magneto summons a Chaos Greatsword that damages enemies in front.
Magneto.enhanced_effect: With Scarlet Witch, Magnetic Cannon can be charged with passive energy to fire Chaos Greatswords.

Magneto.base_effect: Creates a magnetic projection that mirrors Magneto's movement and ability casts from the enemy perspective.
Magneto.enhanced_effect: With Emma Frost, the projection gains much more Health and persists until destroyed or recalled.

Mantis.base_effect: After defeat, Mantis can move as a soul, heal nearby allies, and reforge her body; Natural Anger also enhances Nature Favor self-healing.
Mantis.enhanced_effect: With Adam Warlock, Mantis soul state can create Soul Bond with nearby allies for Healing Over Time and shared damage.

Mantis.base_effect: Recasting Healing Flower on a teammate who already has it enhances and spreads the healing aura.
Mantis.enhanced_effect: With Star-Lord, Healing Flower on any teammate instantly triggers the enhanced spell field and healing effect.

Mister Fantastic.base_effect: Equips the Fantastic Amplifier, increasing maximum Elasticity and allowing active Inflation State entry.
Mister Fantastic.enhanced_effect: With Rocket Raccoon, Brainiac Bounce launches enemies hit.

Mister Fantastic.base_effect: In brawler stance, Stretch Punch becomes a charged Brawling Punch that grants Bonus Health on hit and Launches at full charge.
Mister Fantastic.enhanced_effect: With The Thing, Distended Grip also becomes a charged Distended Hammer that grants Bonus Health and Launches at full charge.

Moon Knight.base_effect: Moon Knight enters Phased state, dashes forward, then emits a Light Energy Healing Wave for himself and nearby allies.
Moon Knight.enhanced_effect: With Cloak & Dagger, Phased duration, dash distance, healing radius, and healing output are increased.

Moon Knight.base_effect: Deploys an Ankh Trap that creates an Ankh and summons one Talon of Khonshu to launch enemies toward its center.
Moon Knight.enhanced_effect: With Elsa Bloodstone, triggering the trap summons multiple Talons of Khonshu to bombard the area.

Namor.base_effect: Summons an extra Gamma Monstro that attacks nearby enemies and gains Attack Speed on critical hits; Wrath of the Seven Seas commands a beam attack.
Namor.enhanced_effect: With Hulk, Blessing of the Deep creates a Gamma water barrier that speeds Gamma Monstro cooldown and gives it Damage Boost.

Namor.base_effect: Namor summons Frost Tide forward, damaging, pushing back, and Slowing enemies hit.
Namor.enhanced_effect: With Luna Snow, Frost Tide gains one charge and crashes at max range for area damage and Slow.

Peni Parker.base_effect: Briefly grants Cyber-Web Cluster Attack Speed and Damage Boost.
Peni Parker.enhanced_effect: With Black Panther, activation deploys a frontal Vibranium Shield and lowers Cyber-Web Cluster Vibranium Energy cost.

Peni Parker.base_effect: Deploys an Armored Spider-Nest that drops Spider-Drones and Armor Packs granting Bonus Health.
Peni Parker.enhanced_effect: With Rocket Raccoon, the Armored Spider-Nest regenerates Health, and Rocket's B.R.B. creates Cyber-Webs plus Spider-Drones and Arachno-Mines.

Phoenix.base_effect: Psionic Detonation becomes Phoenix Netherfire, creating staged explosions that Stun, apply Healing Reduction, and add Sparks.
Phoenix.enhanced_effect: With Hela, every blast applies multiple Spark stacks.

Phoenix.base_effect: Phoenix fires a telekinetic shockwave; on hit, Phoenix Force rushes the target, chains to nearby enemies, applies Sparks, and heals Phoenix.
Phoenix.enhanced_effect: With Rogue, the shockwave is wider and Phoenix Force target detection range increases.

Psylocke.base_effect: Creates an illusion that dashes forward with Psi-Blade Dash while Psylocke enters Stealth; the illusion mimics attacks if Psylocke attacks.
Psylocke.enhanced_effect: With Emma Frost, Psylocke can reactivate the ability to swap positions with the illusion.

Psylocke.base_effect: Releases Light Darts in all directions, damaging enemies, healing Psylocke on hit, and leaving a Shadow Domain that can re-enter Stealth.
Psylocke.enhanced_effect: With Cloak & Dagger, Shadow Domain radius expands and re-entering Stealth fires Light Darts again.

Rocket Raccoon.base_effect: Bombard Mode fires Thorny Spores that damage enemies while healing allies and granting Bonus Health in the impact field.
Rocket Raccoon.enhanced_effect: With Groot, Rocket can ride on Groot's shoulders and the Thorny Spores field lasts longer.

Rocket Raccoon.base_effect: Rocket tosses augmented Vitality Acorns that heal teammates and reduce global cooldowns when hit directly or collected.
Rocket Raccoon.enhanced_effect: With Squirrel Girl, the maximum charge count for the ability increases.

Rogue.base_effect: After activation, Rogue attacks trigger kinetic explosions that damage nearby enemies and heal nearby allies.
Rogue.enhanced_effect: With Gambit, Rogue remains permanently in the Hearts as One state.

Rogue.base_effect: Defensive Stance expands a magnetic field that greatly improves Damage Reduction and converts absorbed damage into Southern Brawl damage.
Rogue.enhanced_effect: With Magneto, Southern Brawl knocks enemies back and deals extra damage if they hit a wall.

Scarlet Witch.base_effect: Chthonian Burst becomes Mystic Burst, a held stream of magical missiles fired in the target direction.
Scarlet Witch.enhanced_effect: With Doctor Strange, maximum Chaos Energy increases and Chaos Control generates energy faster while attacking.

Scarlet Witch.base_effect: Dark Seal becomes a Plasmoid Seal with a secondary detonation that damages enemies and applies Vulnerability.
Scarlet Witch.enhanced_effect: With Jubilee, Scarlet Witch receives constant healing while using Mystic Projection.

Spider-Man.base_effect: Spider-Man gains symbiote abilities and can form explosive spikes that damage and push nearby enemies.
Spider-Man.enhanced_effect: With Venom, additional Touch of Klyntar tendrils tether and damage enemies over time.

Spider-Man.base_effect: Spider-Man receives a timed Sticky Spider-Bomb that damages nearby enemies and applies Spider-Tracer, or recharges Web-Cluster if it times out on him.
Spider-Man.enhanced_effect: With Peni Parker, Web-Cluster Spider-Tracers are upgraded and generate Bonus Health when detonated.

Squirrel Girl.base_effect: Squirrel Girl gains Squirrel Missile, sending a squirrel on Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing explosive missile.
Squirrel Girl.enhanced_effect: With Iron Man, Squirrel Blockade also fires a Squirrel Missile.

Squirrel Girl.base_effect: Spider-Man gives Squirrel Girl a web bomb that explodes on contact, damaging and briefly Slowing enemies.
Squirrel Girl.enhanced_effect: With Spider-Man, Webbed Acorn leaves a sticky Web Area that continuously Slows and can Stun enemies that remain inside.

Star-Lord.base_effect: Star-Lord throws Twisted Thorn Seeds that sprout Thorn Snares, damaging and Rooting enemies who step on them.
Star-Lord.enhanced_effect: With Groot, more Thorn Snares deploy and snare damage is boosted.

Star-Lord.base_effect: Star-Lord places a Telekinetic Beacon he can teleport back to; on defeat, he cocoons and respawns at the beacon.
Star-Lord.enhanced_effect: With Adam Warlock, Star-Lord participation in KOs reduces Telekinetic Beacon cooldown.

Storm.base_effect: Wind Blade becomes a hitscan beam that detonates when it hits a target.
Storm.enhanced_effect: With Thor, Bolt Rush becomes Chain Lightning and bounces between enemies.

Storm.base_effect: Storm calls down rain that continuously heals herself and allies.
Storm.enhanced_effect: With Jeff, Omega Hurricane lets Jeff swim inside the cyclone to create a localized Jeff-nado.

The Punisher.base_effect: The Punisher fires piercing bullets with Damage Boost.
The Punisher.enhanced_effect: With Daredevil, the bullets break summoned walls and shields faster.

The Punisher.base_effect: The Punisher throws an Ammo Overload Device that grants Faster Firing to allies in range.
The Punisher.enhanced_effect: With Rocket Raccoon, the device grants Infinite Ammo.

The Thing.base_effect: The Thing's fists ignite; Rocky Jab deals splash damage and Stone Haymaker explodes in a frontal cone.
The Thing.enhanced_effect: With Human Torch, Human Torch can lift and slam The Thing, damaging and Stunning enemies and putting The Thing into the flaming state.

The Thing.base_effect: Generates Psionic Armor that grants Bonus Health based on missing Health.
The Thing.enhanced_effect: With Invisible Woman, Psionic Armor pulses area healing after The Thing takes enough damage and converts missing Health into more Bonus Health.

Thor.base_effect: Fatal damage is delayed; Thor gains decaying Bonus Health and can revive by participating in a KO.
Thor.enhanced_effect: With Hela, either hero participating in a KO can instantly revive Thor with Health restored from remaining Bonus Health and Continuous Healing.

Thor.base_effect: Throws a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce per enemy hit, then Thor can leap to its explosion point for a second damage wave.
Thor.enhanced_effect: With Angela, leaping to the Thunder Spear grants Bonus Health.

Ultron.base_effect: Imperative: Patch applies to all allies.
Ultron.enhanced_effect: With Peni Parker, Imperative: Firewall applies to all drones so its effects can trigger multiple times at once.

Ultron.base_effect: Encephalo-Ray is upgraded to Nano-Ray, firing multiple damaging nano-projectiles forward.
Ultron.enhanced_effect: With Iron Man, Imperative: Firewall fires homing missiles at enemies in range for area damage.

Venom.base_effect: Cellular Corrosion siphons Health from tethered enemies to heal Venom.
Venom.enhanced_effect: With Blade, Venom gains a burst of one-time healing when using specified abilities.

Venom.base_effect: Venom ignites the symbiote with Phoenix Flames, replacing Dark Predation with a frontal Phoenix Touch slash.
Venom.enhanced_effect: With Phoenix, Phoenix Touch applies Sparks that detonate at three stacks.

White Fox.base_effect: White Fox uses Black Cat's Orb of Life to recover Spirit Tail energy and release Nine-Tailed Aura, healing and speeding allies while damaging and Slowing enemies.
White Fox.enhanced_effect: With Black Cat, using the Orb prevents Spirit Tail energy consumption for a duration, allowing free use of Spectral Surge and Fox Form Awakening.

White Fox.base_effect: Fox Form Awakening no longer consumes Spirit Tail energy and immediately grants its maximum possible duration.
White Fox.enhanced_effect: With Psylocke, Fox Form Awakening's cooldown is greatly reduced.

Winter Soldier.base_effect: Winter Soldier unlocks Burst Spike, emitting electricity forward to damage and Knock Back enemies.
Winter Soldier.enhanced_effect: With The Punisher, the burst also Grounds enemies and increases Knock Back.

Winter Soldier.base_effect: KO participation grants Culling Instinct stacks that reduce other ability cooldowns; stacks are lost on defeat.
Winter Soldier.enhanced_effect: With Elsa Bloodstone, Ceaseless Charge grants more Bonus Health.

Wolverine.base_effect: Extends Savage Claw and Berserk Claw Strike range, and replaces Vicious Rampage with a forward Kinetic Claws slash flurry.
Wolverine.enhanced_effect: With Cyclops, Blast Slash stays permanently active.

Wolverine.base_effect: Wolverine gains Kinetic Enhancement with Movement Speed and Jump Boost; attacks apply delayed explosive Kinetic Particles.
Wolverine.enhanced_effect: With Gambit, Wolverine receives Continuous Healing for the ability duration.
